store: Ossuary Bin round 3: a stone-footed timber outbuilding bin with a gable, nine bays for thirteen kinds of bone: five single bays (front row) and four pair bays (three in the back row, the skulls in the front row) in which two related kinds lie either side of a built-in divider plank; heaped and crowned over the walls when full

frame.atlas_sources: rows 0-31 hewn timber, 32-63 x0-63 end grain, 64-79 iron, 112-127 x96-127 iron (spare): assets/bunker_r4; 32-63 x64-95 dark oiled timber, x96-127 wear swatch: assets/metalpallet_r3; 80-111 four stone-block tiles: assets/orebin_r5; 112-127 x0-95: bone, dark socket, antler (new, for the skull and antler decor)

space: Unity prefab space, origin = footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (convex-hull items, friction 0.75, restitution 0, damping 0.25/0.45), dropped one copy at a time onto the frozen earlier ones; each bay's copy sequence is cut into its units in drop order. Each copy: the item's bounds centre at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position), rotated by copy.quat_xyzw (or copy.euler, Unity ZXY), longest side fit_longest_m. unit.position: x = centre of the unit's copies, y = the bay's mid height, z = the bay's centre. unit.box: x = the copies' width, y = the bay's lowest rotated-bounds corner to its highest copy (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves every settled copy alone), z = 90% of the bay's inner depth.
fill_order: units are listed in fill order (interleaved over the bays); within a bay its units fill in drop order (a heap against the bay's back wall first, crowned over the walls last). Show the first n copies of a unit for a partial stack. Later copies rest on earlier ones, earlier ones never move. One item kind per single bay; a pair bay (bay.shared, two kinds) has a hewn plank built into the model and each kind only on its own units (unit.item says which; the mod draws no board there). Groups 0-2 = back row (all pair bays), 3-8 = front row (bay 6 is the skulls' pair bay), left to right as seen from the front; cell = [column, row], row 1 = back, a pair bay's two halves are consecutive columns (left half first).

divider.kind: hewn plank, built into the model
